# (PART) Group-Level Models {-}

# Hierarchical Models {#hierarchical}

*This chapter has not been written yet.*

So far each participant has been fitted separately, and group questions answered from
the individual estimates. A hierarchical model fits everyone at once, with each person's
parameters drawn from a group distribution. It helps most when people have few trials
each. The chapter will use an existing package (brms or EMC2) rather than building one
from scratch, and compare its group estimates with the individual fits.
